record.question: Electric bulb is invented by
record.explanation: Answer B: Thomal Alva Edison. Thomas Edison is conventionally credited with developing the first commercially practical incandescent lamp, though he did not invent every form of electric lighting or the first light-emitting device. Reference: https://americanhistory.si.edu/lighting/history/patents/ed_inc.htm; https://americanhistory.si.edu/lighting/bios/swan.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
